title: Zero JIT compilation during runtime

### Kimi-K3
- [ ] https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/54784
    - [ ] Enable `--jit-monitor-mode error` on CI for Kimi-K3: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/50109

Complete model de-JITification is achieved when the model can run seamlessly with `--jit-monitor-mode error,` introduced in [#46167](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/46167). Enabling this mode in CI will detect any untracked kernels that still compile at runtime and therefore require additional warmup coverage.
